items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Micky McMickle. Dale McMickle. Yeah. And Clyde Hurley played the open solo. ... That was an Erskine Hawkins thing, wasn’t it? ... McMickle, Clyde Hurley and Lee Knowles.

ctx.x: Who was the man who played the muted trumpet part in that song? © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
Micky McMickle. Dale McMickle. Yeah. And Clyde Hurley played the open solo.
That was an Erskine Hawkins thing, wasn’t it?
